mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 83 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 52.

The city is moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail project, which includes paving and bridge replacements to ensure year-round accessibility. Also, make sure to check out the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics public art sculpture now on display at Century School Park.

There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today and Hop Haus Trivia also taking place today. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
The Verona Police Department reported a variety of incidents last week, including medical emergencies and car versus parked car crashes.
Culver's is currently open until 10 PM and is serving the delicious Snickers Swirl as today's flavor of the day, so stop by for a treat.
